title: Verify read-only tracker capability before approving Codex child MCP tools
outcome: Verify read-only tracker capability before approving Codex child MCP tools
acceptance: A compatible read-only tracker remains usable for the five admitted read words, and a binary or wrapper tolerating an unsupported --read-only flag cannot expose writing variants with selective approval.
TermAl omits selective MCP tool approval for an incompatible configured tracker binary, using a bounded capability or pinned identity check.
